detail.longDescription: Mingji Dai (Emroy University, USA) recently published the first # totalsynthesis of the # alkaloid stemocurtisine in the journal # JACS (10.1021/jacs.6c12593) using a palladium catalysed carbonylation for lactone formation. I summarised his synthetic route on my collection of total syntheses and added two exercises for advanced # chemistry # students Check out here: https://www. organicchemistry.eu/books/tota l-syntheses-of-natural-products/page/first-total-synthesis-of-stemocurtisine-m-dai-2026 # science # research
